title: Italian Baked Fish Bowl
description: A healthy and flavorful Italian dish that combines the freshness of fish with the simplicity of a bowl.

ingredients.name: Roasted Vegetables
ingredients.notes: such as zucchini, bell peppers, and cherry tomatoes

instructions: Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Place the bass fillets on the prepared baking sheet.
Drizzle with olive oil, lemon juice, and sprinkle with garlic, Italian seasoning, and salt.
Bake for 12-15 minutes or until the fish is cooked through.
While the fish is baking, cook the quinoa according to package instructions.
Toss the roasted vegetables with a drizzle of olive oil, salt, and pepper.
To assemble the bowls, place a cooked bass fillet on top of a bed of quinoa.
Add the roasted vegetables and sprinkle with chopped parsley.
